outputs.explanation: Panel A is a stacked bar chart showing median promoter-state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin (aggregated across many promoters), but no individual data points (per-promoter values) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel B is a single-molecule raster plot in which every row is an individual DNA molecule; the raw individual data are already fully displayed, so the accompanying state-frequency sidebar does not need additional overlay of individual points.
Panel C is the mouse counterpart of panel A, a stacked bar chart of median state frequencies per bin with no individual promoter data points shown.
Panel D is the mouse counterpart of panel B; individual molecules are shown as rows in the raster plot, so this is already raw/individual data display.

Panel E is a box plot, which by convention already conveys the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points); box plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
Panel F is a box plot, which by convention already conveys the data distribution; box plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
